updates.title: Claude Adds Support for MCP 2026-07-28 Spec: Stateless Core, Hardened Auth, and New Extensions
updates.summary: Anthropic updated Claude to support the new MCP 2026-07-28 specification — described as the largest MCP update since the protocol's launch. The spec moves MCP from a bidirectional stateful protocol to a stateless request/response model, enabling servers to deploy on serverless and edge infrastructure and scale horizontally behind any load balancer. Additional highlights include stronger OAuth and OIDC authorization, versioned extensions for Apps (server-rendered sandboxed UIs) and Tasks (long-running async operations), enterprise-managed auth, observability connectors, and private network tunnels. MCP has surpassed 400M monthly SDK downloads, a 4x increase in 2026.
updates.accuracy_notes: Confirmed via multiple independent sources: Anthropic's official blog (claude.com/blog), the Model Context Protocol blog (blog.modelcontextprotocol.io/posts/2026-07-28/), X/@ClaudeDevs announcement, and Releasebot's Anthropic changelog. All sources corroborate the July 28 date and feature list. No red flags or unverified claims detected.
